purpose: Candidate first known-truth fixture for Earth Interior Observatory local-observability and inversion benchmarks.

dataset.title: Replication Data for: Geodynamo simulations spanning millennia in the physical conditions of Earth's core
dataset.creator: Aubert, Julien
dataset.description: Published simulation outputs include core-surface magnetic field, velocity field and magnetic diffusion from documented cases U, G, N, C, GC and GL. They are simulated known-truth data, not the Earth's observed trajectory.

related_publication.title: Geodynamo simulations spanning millennia in the physical conditions of Earth's core

candidate_file.provider_reported_description: Magnetic field data for case C

permitted_initial_use: Inspect variable names, array shapes, units and temporal coordinate conventions.
Build a frozen small fixture with known simulation truth after parsing is independently reviewed.
Construct a separately versioned observation operator to sample simulated field values as synthetic satellite/ground observations.
Compare local observability estimates with recovery errors on known-truth parameter perturbations.
prohibited_claims: Do not call this dataset direct observation of the real Earth.
Do not claim the provider MD5 authenticates the publisher; it only assists transfer-integrity checking.
Do not report local_sha256 or payload verification as complete until the bytes are downloaded and independently hashed.
Do not commit bulk source arrays to this repository; preserve provenance and deterministic retrieval instructions.

verification_plan: Inspect dataset README and data-file metadata before parsing.
Acquire the exact dataset version and file ID using an approved retrieval path.
Verify downloaded bytes against the provider-reported MD5 and independently compute SHA-256.
Record parser version, MAT format/version, variables, shapes, units, model time basis, and any conversions.
Freeze contiguous temporal train/validation/test intervals; test at least one held-out documented case if scientifically defensible.
Keep truth arrays, synthetic observations, transforms, and inference outputs as separate artifacts.
